claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus in the form of an end cap for a stringer, the end cap comprising:
2. The apparatus of claim 1 wherein: a cross section of the end cap is a "T" shape.
3. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the cross section of the end cap is a hat shape.
4. The apparatus according to claims 1 to 3 wherein: the web (310) forms a curved shape.
5. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 4 wherein: the end cap is made from Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP).
6. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the end cap is made from metal.
7. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 6 wherein: the end cap includes mounting features in a flange.
8. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 7 wherein: the end cap includes mounting features in a web.

9. An apparatus in the form of flyaway tooling for an aircraft, the apparatus comprising: an end cap according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the end cap is configured to support a preform for a stringer during fabrication, and is configured to be integrated into a completed stringer as a component of the aircraft.

10. The apparatus of any preceding claim, further comprising a stringer preform, wherein the ramps (322, 1022, 312, 1012) are overlapped by corresponding ramps in the stringer preform, such that an overall thickness of the combination of flange (320, 1020) and stringer preform remains constant along the flange (320, 1020).
11. The apparatus of claim 10, further comprising a wing panel, wherein the end cap is bonded to an outboard end of the stringer preform and fastened to the wing panel.
12. The apparatus of claim 11, further comprising another end cap bonded to an inboard end of the stringer preform and fastened to the wing panel.

13. The apparatus according to claim 10, wherein the end cap is an inboard end cap, the apparatus further comprising a wing box and a web extension (1030), wherein the web extension (1030) terminates the stringer by abutting against a side of body intersection at an end of the stringer to transfer load from the wing box, and the ramps (1012, 1022) are configured to transfer load from the stringer to a center of the wing box.
14. The apparatus of any preceding claim, wherein the ramps (322, 1022, 312, 1012) are selected from the group consisting of step laps, linear ramps, scarfing, and interleaving.
15. A method of fabricating a portion of an aircraft using an apparatus in the form of an end cap for a stringer, the end cap comprising:
